This update fixes problems with large photos, Arabic text and copied document names, along with a few settings improvements.

## Fixes

- Large images now respect graphics limits while keeping their original resolution. Windows HEIF decoding also has enough temporary memory for the reported 51 MP photo.
- Arabic interface text has corrected word order and better handling of filenames, numbers, cursor movement, selection and copying.
- Duplicated documents use names such as `photo (copy).jpg`, and Save As keeps that name when changing formats.
- JPEG XL stays available in Open without the export pack. Installed font packs apply immediately, without restarting.
- Unexpected interface errors now show an error message with the log location.

## Interface

- Language and label customisation are now together in Preferences > Interface.
- The label editor has a clearer name, a visible Reset all button and fewer repetitive tooltips.

Related to issues 207, 198, 195 and 199, and discussion 194.
